title: Cohabiting adults aged 50+, 2000 vs 2022 (count)

source.name: Cohabitation in Middle and Later Life, 2022 (Family Profile FP-24-14)
source.publisher: Bowling Green State University, National Center for Family & Marriage Research (using Census/ACS data)

notes: Among adults aged 50 and older, the number cohabiting (unmarried, living with a partner) rose from about 1.2 million in 2000 to about 4,205,505 in 2022 -- almost a fourfold increase.
